types.name: changelog.v1.Audience
types.doc: Audience is a group of users a change is addressed to.

types.name: changelog.v1.Change
types.doc: Change is one announced change. A republished post may reword or withdraw it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Stable opaque 64-bit identifier, identical across environments and across
 revisions of a post.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Short title.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: One-paragraph summary.

fields.name: details
fields.doc: Longer explanation; paragraphs separated by blank lines. Omitted when absent.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Category.

fields.name: action_required
fields.doc: True when users or integrators must act.

fields.name: migration_guidance
fields.doc: What to do, when action is required. Omitted when absent.

fields.name: audiences
fields.doc: Audiences addressed. Never empty.

fields.name: surfaces
fields.doc: Product areas affected. May be empty.

fields.name: environment_exceptions
fields.doc:
Environments where this change differs from its release's status, in any
 environment, not only this one. Empty outside release posts and when the
 change follows its release everywhere.

types.name: changelog.v1.ChangeAvailability
types.doc:
ChangeAvailability is how one change of a release differs from its release
 in one environment.

values.name: AHEAD
values.doc: Available in the environment while its release is still pending there.

values.name: PENDING
values.doc: Not yet available in the environment although its release is live there.

values.name: UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Not available in the environment for now, whatever its release's status.

types.name: changelog.v1.ChangeCategory
types.doc: ChangeCategory classifies one change.

values.name: BREAKING_CHANGE
values.doc: Breaking change: existing integrations may need to change.

types.name: changelog.v1.ChangeEntry
types.doc: ChangeEntry is one change with the post that announced it.

fields.name: change
fields.doc: The change.

fields.name: post_slug
fields.doc: Slug of the announcing post.

fields.name: published_at
fields.doc: Time of first publication of the announcing post.

fields.name: section_heading
fields.doc: Heading of the section containing the change.

types.name: changelog.v1.ChangeException
types.doc:
ChangeException is the status of one change in one environment where it
 differs from its release's status.

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: Environment.

fields.name: availability
fields.doc: How the change differs from its release there.

fields.name: live_at
fields.doc: When the change became available in the environment; set for AHEAD only.

types.name: changelog.v1.DeploymentGroup
types.doc: DeploymentGroup is one complete deployment group.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: Group summary.

fields.name: attention
fields.doc:
Breaking changes and changes with action_required across the group's
 posts, in post order (ascending release), then section and change order.

fields.name: highlights
fields.doc: Highlights of the group's posts, in post order.

types.name: changelog.v1.DeploymentGroupAttention
types.doc:
DeploymentGroupAttention is one change of a deployment group that needs
 attention.

fields.name: post_slug
fields.doc: Slug of the release post that announces the change.

fields.name: release_version
fields.doc: Release of that post.

fields.name: change
fields.doc: The change, as in its post.

types.name: changelog.v1.DeploymentGroupHighlight
types.doc:
DeploymentGroupHighlight is one highlight of a release post in a deployment
 group.

fields.name: post_slug
fields.doc: Slug of the release post.

fields.name: release_version
fields.doc: Release of that post.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Highlight text, inline Markdown.

types.name: changelog.v1.DeploymentGroupPost
types.doc:
DeploymentGroupPost is one published release post a deployment group
 brought.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc: Post slug, for example "v0.92.9".

fields.name: release_version
fields.doc: Release the post announces, for example "0.92.9".

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Post title.

fields.name: published_at
fields.doc: Time of first publication of the post.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Published revision of the post, starting at 1.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the post's current revision was published.

types.name: changelog.v1.DeploymentGroupSummary
types.doc:
DeploymentGroupSummary describes one deployment group without its details.
 A deployment group is one deployment to this environment that raised its
 release version, and brought every release above the previous group's
 version up to and including its own.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc:
Stable shareable identifier: the environment and the group's own
 release, for example "testnet-v0.92.9". It never changes.

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: Environment the group was deployed to.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.doc: When the deployment ran.

fields.name: release_version
fields.doc: The group's own, highest release, for example "0.92.9".

fields.name: release_tag
fields.doc:
Release tag of the group's own release, for example "v0.92.9". Omitted
 when unknown.

fields.name: previous_release_version
fields.doc: Release of the previous deployment group. Omitted for the first group.

fields.name: versions
fields.doc:
Every release the group brought, ascending, for example ["0.92.8",
 "0.92.9"].

fields.name: posts
fields.doc:
Published release posts of those releases, ascending by release. A
 release without a published post has none.

types.name: changelog.v1.Environment
types.doc: Environment is a Polyester network with its own changelog.

types.name: changelog.v1.EnvironmentStatus
types.doc: EnvironmentStatus says whether a release is live in one environment.

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: Environment.

fields.name: live_at
fields.doc:
When the release went live in the environment. Omitted while it is
 pending there.

types.name: changelog.v1.GetDeploymentGroupRequest
types.doc: GetDeploymentGroupRequest selects one deployment group.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc: Group slug, for example "testnet-v0.92.9".

types.name: changelog.v1.GetDeploymentGroupResponse
types.doc: GetDeploymentGroupResponse returns one complete deployment group.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: The group with its attention changes and highlights.

types.name: changelog.v1.GetPostRequest
types.doc: GetPostRequest selects one post.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc: Post slug.

types.name: changelog.v1.GetPostResponse
types.doc: GetPostResponse returns one complete post.

fields.name: post
fields.doc:
The post with every section and change. A post can hold several hundred
 changes; use ListChanges with post_slug to page through them instead.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListChangesRequest
types.doc:
ListChangesRequest queries changes across posts. Filters on different fields
 combine with AND; values within one field combine with OR.

cel.message: end_time must be after start_time when both are set

fields.name: categories
fields.doc: Categories to include. Empty means all.

fields.name: action_required
fields.doc: When set, only changes whose action_required equals this value.

fields.name: surfaces
fields.doc: Surfaces to include. Empty means all.

fields.name: audiences
fields.doc:
Audiences to include. Empty means all. Changes addressed to ALL_USERS
 always match.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: Inclusive lower bound on post publication time. Optional.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Exclusive upper bound on post publication time. Optional; must be after
 start_time when both are set.

fields.name: post_slug
fields.doc: Restrict to one post. Optional.

fields.name: sort
fields.doc: Order of posts. Changes keep publication order inside each post.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum changes to return. 0 means the default of 100; maximum 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Reuse
 it only with the same filters, time bounds and sort. When the post it
 points into was republished since, paging restarts at the first change of
 that post's current revision, so changes of that post can appear again;
 match them by id.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListChangesResponse
types.doc: ListChangesResponse returns matching changes.

fields.name: changes
fields.doc: Matching changes in the requested order.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListDeploymentGroupsRequest
types.doc:
ListDeploymentGroupsRequest pages through this environment's deployment
 groups, newest first.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum groups to return. 0 means the default of 20; maximum 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response.
 Bound to deployment time and slug.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListDeploymentGroupsResponse
types.doc:
ListDeploymentGroupsResponse returns deployment group summaries, newest
 first.

fields.name: groups
fields.doc:
Group summaries ordered by deployment time descending, then slug
 descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListPostsRequest
types.doc: ListPostsRequest pages through published posts, newest first.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum posts to return. 0 means the default of 20; maximum 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response.
 Bound to publication time and slug.

types.name: changelog.v1.ListPostsResponse
types.doc: ListPostsResponse returns post summaries, newest first.

fields.name: posts
fields.doc: Post summaries ordered by publication time descending, then slug descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: changelog.v1.Post
types.doc: Post is one complete published post at its current revision.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: Post summary.

fields.name: sections
fields.doc: Sections in publication order.

types.name: changelog.v1.PostSummary
types.doc: PostSummary describes one published post without its changes.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc:
Stable post identifier, unique within this environment. It never changes
 when the post is republished.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Title.

fields.name: introduction
fields.doc: Introduction.

fields.name: published_at
fields.doc: Time of first publication. It never changes when the post is republished.

fields.name: coverage_cutoff
fields.doc: Exclusive upper bound of the period covered. Omitted when unknown.

fields.name: change_count
fields.doc: Exact number of changes.

fields.name: breaking_change_count
fields.doc: Exact number of BREAKING_CHANGE changes.

fields.name: action_required_count
fields.doc: Exact number of changes with action_required.

fields.name: new_feature_count
fields.doc: Exact number of NEW_FEATURE changes.

fields.name: improvement_count
fields.doc: Exact number of IMPROVEMENT changes.

fields.name: bug_fix_count
fields.doc: Exact number of BUG_FIX changes.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the current revision was published; equals published_at for revision 1.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc:
Published revision, starting at 1. Each republication of the post, for
 example to correct its copy or withdraw a change, increments it.

fields.name: release_version
fields.doc:
Release the post announces, for example "0.92.9". Omitted for posts that
 do not announce one release. A release post has the same slug, for
 example "v0.92.9", and the same content in every environment, and is
 listed in every environment, including environments where it is still
 pending.

fields.name: environments
fields.doc:
Status of the post's release in each environment: DEVNET, TESTNET and
 MAINNET, in that order. Empty for posts without release_version. The
 status changes when the release goes live, without a new revision.

fields.name: deployment_group_slug
fields.doc:
Slug of the deployment group that brought the release to this
 environment. Omitted while the release is pending here and for posts
 without release_version.

types.name: changelog.v1.Section
types.doc: Section groups related changes inside a post.

fields.name: heading
fields.doc: Section heading.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: Section summary. Omitted when absent.

fields.name: changes
fields.doc: Changes in publication order.

fields.name: surface
fields.doc:
Product area of the section. SURFACE_UNSPECIFIED for sections not tied to
 one area (for example changes that need your attention, or general).

types.name: changelog.v1.SortDirection
types.doc: SortDirection orders changes by post publication time.

types.name: changelog.v1.Surface
types.doc: Surface is the product area a change affects.

values.name: TRADING
values.doc: Orders, triggers and protective orders, and order outcomes.

values.name: MARKET_DATA
values.doc: Market data: prices, candles, order book, heatmaps and market overviews.

values.name: REWARDS
values.doc: Rewards: daily claims, campaigns, VIP tiers and fee discounts.

values.name: ASSISTANT
values.doc: The AI assistant: chats, approvals, memories and preferences.
